svg.text: Slap: solder 11 pins, then wire (board as in your photo, USB ports at the top)
Header strips go in the breadboard first, long pins DOWN. Board on top, chips up. Solder only the ringed pins. Leave the board in the breadboard afterwards.
holes i and j beside each right-column pin are free: plug the wires there
Solder these 11 pins (red rings), nothing else
Right column, top to bottom: GND (top, next to 5Vin), 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3V3 (very bottom)
Left column: GND at the very top and GND at the very bottom (support + spare grounds)
Iron ~330 °C. Pin and pad together 2 s, feed solder, 1 s more, lift. Shiny cone = good.
Check by eye that no two neighbours are bridged (especially 3V3 / RST and GND / 5Vin).
Unsoldered pins just sit in the plastic strip and do nothing. No USB until you are done.
GND (top left) → the other blue − rail
GND → blue rail VDD → red rail SCL → 9 SDA → 8
Mic INMP441 (6 wires), tiny hole facing up
VDD → red rail GND → blue rail L/R → blue rail
VCC → red rail GND → blue rail INT → 7
SCL → 9 SDA → 8 (second wire on 9 and 8: one in hole i, one in hole j)
10 → 220 Ω → LED long leg LED short leg → blue rail
board alone (serial log) → OLED (join code) → mic (captions) → IMU (slap wakes it) → LED
